archetype: THE PERFORMANCE PRO / BROADCAST AV CONSOLE (Refined & Minimalist)
app_style: Pro Broadcast Operator Console — Ultra-Clean, Precision AV Aesthetics, Tablet-First

hierarchy.panel_title: font-medium text-xs sm:text-sm uppercase tracking-wider text-muted-foreground

spacing_and_layout.container: max-w-[1600px] mx-auto p-3 sm:p-5 lg:p-6 min-h-screen flex flex-col justify-between gap-4 sm:gap-6
spacing_and_layout.grid_structure: grid grid-cols-1 lg:grid-cols-12 gap-4 lg:gap-6 items-stretch flex-grow
spacing_and_layout.header_height: h-16 border-b backdrop-blur-md px-4 sm:px-6 flex items-center justify-between z-40 sticky top-0
spacing_and_layout.transcript_split: lg:col-span-6 flex flex-col h-[calc(100vh-280px)] min-h-[420px] rounded-2xl border p-4 sm:p-6 backdrop-blur-xl shadow-xl transition-all duration-300 relative overflow-hidden
spacing_and_layout.control_bar: flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-4 p-4 rounded-2xl border bg-surface backdrop-blur-xl shadow-lg

header.style: Glassmorphic header with hairline border (border-white/10), crisp typography, clear live status indicators badge, and accessible icon controls.

level_meter.style: Tactile broadcast VU meter with segmented gradient bars (Green > Amber > Red), peak hold indicator, smooth dB numerical readout, and dedicated 'TEST INPUT' tactile button.
level_meter.peak_indicator: Active pink/red pulse when clipping occurs (> -3dB)

primary_start_button.start_state: bg-emerald-600 hover:bg-emerald-500 text-white shadow-[0_0_25px_rgba(16,185,129,0.3)] hover:scale-[1.02] active:scale-[0.98] transition-all font-semibold rounded-xl text-base px-8 py-3.5 flex items-center gap-2
primary_start_button.stop_state: bg-rose-600 hover:bg-rose-500 text-white shadow-[0_0_25px_rgba(239,68,68,0.3)] animate-pulse hover:scale-[1.02] active:scale-[0.98] transition-all font-semibold rounded-xl text-base px-8 py-3.5 flex items-center gap-2

transcript_panels.source_panel: Subtle cool slate background with high-contrast readable typography for original speech stream.
transcript_panels.translation_panel: Rich deep obsidian/navy background with glowing accent scroll indicator and dynamic line highlight for incoming target interpretation.
transcript_panels.fullscreen_mode: Immersive dark stage mode that maximizes text size for long-distance viewing across church halls, auditoriums, and seminar rooms.

instructions_to_main_agent: Retain ALL existing data-testid attributes on all interactive elements, containers, metrics, and modals without exception.
Do NOT change backend endpoints or WebRTC/OpenAI Realtime logic; this is purely a visual UI/UX refinement.
Ensure dark mode is default with seamless toggle to light mode.
Apply subtle glassmorphism (backdrop-blur-xl), fine 1px slate/white borders (border-white/10), and high-contrast typography.
Maintain high legibility in the transcript panels for distant viewing on tablets or broadcast monitors.
Provide clear interactive states (hover, focus, active, disabled) on every button and control with smooth CSS transitions.
Use JetBrains Mono or monospace font for timers, latency metrics, dB meters, and technical readouts.

UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.avoid_slop: Do not build cheap generic centered designs. Use broadcast-grade precision, subtle ambient glows on active states, clean grid hierarchy, and tailored line-heights.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.spacing: Ensure touch-friendly target areas on tablets (minimum 44x44px for main controls).
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.accessibility: Ensure text contrast ratio meets WCAG AA (>= 4.5:1) in both dark and light modes.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.test_ids: Every button, input, selector, switch, meter, and display panel MUST retain its specified data-testid.
